mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 with potential for increased statin levels and perphenazine accumulation; perphenazine may increase myopathy risk through additive effects on muscle metabolism.
action: Monitor for statin-related myopathy symptoms and perphenazine adverse effects; consider lower atorvastatin doses or alternative antipsychotic if myopathy develops; periodic CK monitoring may be warranted.
